title: Garrincha's birth chart
metaDescription: Garrincha's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 4.8° Scorpio. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled fall in mutable signs, the widest weighting the unknown hour leaves certain. Mutable signs end their seasons, and a mutable-heavy chart is read as one built for adaptation and hand-off rather than for standing still.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Measured rather than labelled, the Sun holds 4.8° Scorpio: the first decan, whose classical sub-ruler is Mars. A water sign, read here in its first face.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 28.5° Scorpio; Venus stands at 19.9° Sagittarius; Mars stands at 13.8° Sagittarius. The tradition reads a mind that absorbs before it argues from Mercury, taste that runs toward the vivid and the immediate from Venus, drive that ignites on contact from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Uranus and Pluto — a square holding at 0.3°. A square is the tradition’s engine room: two drives at cross purposes, and the friction is the horsepower. Behind it, Jupiter trine Saturn at 0.5°, and Mars square Neptune at 2.1° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Each angle here was measured at every hour of the civil day and held; whatever the missing clock said, this geometry was in it.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: The day-stable angles form no closed figure. Nothing funnels; each aspect is its own negotiation, which the tradition reads as a chart of separate treaties rather than one campaign.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The classical table has one entry for this chart. Saturn in Aquarius at 9.9° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 4 in water, 3 in fire, 2 in air, 1 in earth by element, 4 mutable, 3 fixed, 3 cardinal by modality. A water emphasis reads as porousness: the room is registered whole, long before it is analysed in parts. Uranus and Pluto were retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Pisces for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.3° between midnight and midnight. Fast enough that its degree is approximate, slow enough that its sign is not in doubt. At the noon reference it stands at 8.8°.
